name: flash-theater
description: flash-theater — a precompiler for Roku/BrightScript/SceneGraph. Currently compiles a single .thr component to .xml/.brs, running on a real Roku device.
author: Błażej Chełkowski

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/flash-parser && npm run build --workspace packages/compiler
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace packages/flash-parser && npm run test --workspace packages/flash-parser && npm run test --workspace packages/compiler
